The Topology Boundary Auditor's high confidence mask (0.978) might be misleading here if it only segmented the main railing mass and ignored the subtle fusion zones with people. The Router's visual observation of fusion is more reliable than the auditor's binary mask success.
3. Perspective Distortion (Severity 1.5): The escalator steps show slight warping. This is consistent with AI-generated architectural lines often failing to maintain perfect parallelism in depth.

It implies the geometric arrangement of the railings (curved, metallic, reflective) might have been generated with such aberrant perspective or shape that it resembles a satellite dish rather than a staircase railing. This supports the 'structural collapse' observation—the geometry is fundamentally confused.
